# utf8proc

Vendored without modifications from JuliaStrings/utf8proc **v2.11.3**:
https://github.com/JuliaStrings/utf8proc/tree/v2.11.3

Unicode data version: **17.0.0**. L^ uses the stateful extended grapheme
cluster boundary algorithm and UTF-8 decoder. Built statically into lhat;
no download or external library is required to build or run it.

See LICENSE.md for the MIT and Unicode data licenses.

`tests/data/GraphemeBreakTest-17.0.0.txt` is the corresponding unmodified
Unicode conformance test from:
https://www.unicode.org/Public/17.0.0/ucd/auxiliary/GraphemeBreakTest.txt
